title: Automated Evidence Collection Agents
summary: Implementation of AI-driven agents that connect to third-party systems (AWS, GitHub, Google Workspace) to automatically verify compliance controls and collect evidence, replacing manual screenshots.
goals: Reduce manual effort in collecting audit evidence by 80%.
Enable near real-time validation of technical controls.
Provide immutable audit trails of compliance checks.

user_stories.outcome: the system automatically verifies that branch protection rules are enabled.
see a JSON log or screenshot generated by the system today, rather than a manual upload from last month.
evidence is collected daily, weekly, or monthly automatically.

architecture.description: Base class for all integrations. Each service (GitHub, AWS) will have a specific adapter.

new_models: EvidenceCheck (stores the result of a run)
ControlMapping (links a technical check to a specific Compliance Control)

acceptance_criteria: User can securely save API keys/OAuth tokens for a provider.
System can run a check (e.g., 'MFA Enabled') and return Pass/Fail.
Pass/Fail result is automatically attached to the relevant Control as Evidence.
